newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rostelekom 97 Q1 pre-tax 468 bln rbls vs 768 bln.
newsitem.headline: Rostelekom 97 Q1 pre-tax 468 bln rbls vs 768 bln.

text.p: NOTES -- Figures prepared to Russian standards on an accruals basis.
The Russian government owns 38 percent in Rostelekom, and is transferring its stake to holding company Svyazinvest.
Russian accounting standards differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities.
Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
